notes: colourMatik 1.7.5 — consistent matches, every time: the stable curve-based transfer (tone + white balance + palette, the way a colourist grades) is now the incumbent winner in Different-scene mode, and an exotic distribution map must beat it by a clear 25% margin — after the frame-damage penalties — to ship.
